snippet.title: Gram Games | Merged! Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Merged! is the latest title from Gram Games, the makers of the global smash hit 1010!. 

Merged! is easy to learn and challenging to master. Your aim is to match the numbered blocks on the grid and amass the highest score. Connecting three ones will create a two block, three two blocks will create a three block and so on, up to the special M block. Match three M blocks to create an explosion and clear nine blocks on the grid. Merged! is an engaging puzzle game you won’t be able to put down.

DOWNLOAD NOW!
http://merged.it
